reviews.title: Delayed worst customer service
reviews.text: Worst airlines ever, delayed by 16hrs and all the customer service at malaysia/staff are not helpful they will handball you to freaking everyone. Wouldn’t use the airlines again. No explanations of delayed and you will only get a $20 voucher for food , what if I have wedding to attend or a important matter? Worst experience ever they should pay the day that we got delayed but they will ask you to do million steps. We even payed for an extra insurance pretty useless.I would even rate them as a -10 if I can. People are rude at malaysian airlines worst ever. Can’t even smile no plan/preparation in these type of situations.
reviews.author: Adrian

reviews.title: Reccomend flying Malay
reviews.text: It The flight was amazing.The flight was one of the best.One thing could be improved in check in process but overall I think you should fly this Airline.
reviews.author: Noah Sophia Sar... H

reviews.title: Not the home of hospitality they claim
reviews.text: KUL from LHR I decided to upgrade our seats at check in. When I saw my boarding pass I found that the seats were not what I booked. My family including children were spread out. When I called customer services they said that payment had not gone through but my bank said otherwise. I then had to spend 2 hours sorting it out. The flight from DPS to KL was an hour and a half delayed. Almost no information given. On the plane during meal service I was told that there was only seafood left. I cannot eat this so the staff found me a meal. I noticed a lot of people had asked for chicken and were told they ran out. It was obvious that the crew wanted to get rid of the seafood meals as they then went and heated up a whole batch of chicken. From KL to LHR. I had prepaid for seats in May. When checking in the seats they gave us were different and not the seats I had booked and paid for. I complained and after waiting for over an hour at check in they allocated our original seats. Once we got to the gate we were asked to move to the side. We were then told they have allocated us new seats. These new seats had us spread out across the plane. After complaining yet again and saying I wanted my original seats back I was told they had been given to another family. Eventually they asked other passengers to move so my wife and 2 children could sit together.
reviews.author: Sid_The_Gunner

reviews.title: VERY POOR CUSTOMER SERVICE. THEY PROMISE REFUND AND IT NEVER ARRIVES
reviews.text: Re: 5YGQ7S MA informed me on the 2 August 2023 that my flight had changed, the new time was not suitable for me. They offered me a refund which I submitted an immediate request for. I had booked flex tickets that allowed cancellation and full refund regardless. Whilst I was still in the UK I tried calling the contact centre from the UK many times and was on hold for over an hour each time before getting cut off before anyone picked up. I followed up with emails, and I provided my credit card details on at least three occasions to the Refund Team and each time I was told my refund was being processed. As the refund did not arrive I submitted a customer contact form online. Eventually Nevidarshini (Nevi) Customer Relations – Airline Business - contacted me and said on 9/8/2023 the refund had been processed. However I’ve still not received this refund!! Neither has Nevi replied to my subsequent emails about my refund which is very poor customer service. I purposefully booked with Malaysia Airlines as I thought they were a reputable and reliable company. I also booked the flex ticket to give me flexibility. I am very disappointed with their customer service and I should not have to be constantly chasing them for my refund. DO NOT USE THIS AIRLINE. THEY MAKE AIR ASIA LOOK WORLD CLASS
reviews.author: Italia2019!

reviews.title: Nightmare for PET Travellers - NEVER AGAIN Travel on MH
reviews.text: From the word go! The MH website says, "Plan your trip" and I did exactly that, only to experience the exact opposite - - Find me if you can - Website doesn't respond to your query, made umpteen international calls to their hotline to get no solution to how I can add my pet to my ticket and if the pet & crate size was as per their requirement, - Jackpot! Mumbai reservation number I got through, felt like I hit a jackpot! After many reminders I received a conformation email regarding our pet dog & crate size ok to travel with us!! - Hole in our pocket!!The email had a reminder to book any services like excess baggage 24hours prior to our shock I was not able to buy excess baggage, was informed at the check in counter that i should have done it 48hours prior! A huge hole in the pocket indeed! - Trauma & Nightmare begins - when we reach KUL to transit to MNL we see our pet's crate has been offloaded and kept on the hot scotching tarmac as its too big to fit. We are asked to take a call if we want to board the flight or not and the pet is definitely not going! What kind of a choice is that! No solution, No options, pure panic! With great difficulty we got to speak with the DO Raja and showing him the written confirmation, we had received. Based on which we decided to go with MH. Raja heard us patiently and was ready to work with us to come up with a solution finally. Thanks for that, they agreed to put us on the next flight the next day, but we had to arrange for the new crate to fit the flight hold. - some sweet moments in this chaos - the ground staff Raja (she was a true angel) made sure she was by our side beyond her shift hours to ensure the crate was changed and our pet was fed and taken to the pet hotel safely. I want to truly thank her for a genuine concern and care. Azim was the other ground staff who was assigned to us by the DO to assist us, he sincerely assisted us without actually having any experience in such a case. A big Thank you Azim. - Sleepless night with anticipation we waited next day to watch our pet being loaded, Suresh the Loading officer successfully managed to load him and personally came to tell us that our pet was in! Thank you Suresh! Finally we could breathe. "Unreachable, unresponsive, Misinformation, Unequipped & untrained staff to handle pets or scenario like this made it a perfect recipe for trauma!" Till date we have not yet received the procedure to claim GST refund on the excess baggage we paid, despite of many reminder emails to BOMFPFF@malaysiaairlines.com......I sadly give up!! This trip was supposed to a memorable relocation trip, unfortunately we will remember it now for not so happy reasons!!!
reviews.author: Jagruti C

reviews.title: 1 hour 55 mins to flight time and check in still open
reviews.text: As a frequent traveler, all check in counters always open at least 3 hours ahead of time. Its 1 hour 55 mins, there's a whole long queue of people waiting and the check in counter is not even open yet. Don't understand why they would think it's acceptable to let their customers stand in long queue to wait for them being late in opening their counter.
reviews.author: risenangel7

reviews.title: !!! TRAVELLERS BEWARE !!!
reviews.text: Had to cancel our flight due to Covid in Dec 2021. Malaysia Airlines had advertised a full refund if a trip has to be cancelled due to Covid. Took 1 year and 4 months to get my money back for 3 adult tickets after a lot of hours on the customer service line, being cut off from the calls on numerous occasions, countless emails back and forth with customer service that eventually lead to dud emails, which eventually led me have to contact them on their Facebook page and constantly question when I will get my money back- do checkout their FB page, theres are TONS of travellers hounding Malaysia Airlines for their money back, complaining of travel vouchers that Malaysia Airlines have unfairly deemed expired, uninformed flight cancellations, etc. So TRAVELLERS BEWARE!!!
reviews.author: Daezyone

reviews.title: Given up on MAS  Will fly other airlines
reviews.text: Our family recently took several flights on MAS Business Class for holiday and found the overall experience to be hugely disappointing. From the moment we booked online to the faulty MAS App and customer services (email, FB, Call Centre and IG) were all underwhelming and failed to resolve my simple issues. MAS and Enrich seem to operate like 2 totally different entities making the experience somehow frustrating to resolve even simplest matter of getting our Enrich Number captured on the booking. Considering KLIA being MAS home base, the Golden Lounge at the Satellite Terminal serves a disappointing buffet, bordering sad state, at any time of the day…. The Product. We recently been on 737, A330-200 and A330-300 Business Class. To sum it up, the offering is very very dated and signs of wear is obvious especially 50% of our seats have something not working or broken (ie: reading light, screen, seat adjustment, tray). The IFE selection is OK but not great. And its very very SLOW. The onboard F&B is fine but tasted normal and not worthy of Business Class. Even their signature Satay wasn’t as good as what it used to be. Service from the crew was courteous and acceptable. But even on an overnight flight we weren’t issued amenity kit. On disembarkation on one of the flight, I left a small bag with valuable content at my single seat and promptly reported to the customer service. Hoping the crew or cleaning services will send to Lost & Found..Nope. Someone decided to keep it…. Imagine having dishonest people who would steal from passengers?! The only positive takeaway from our recent flights were - on time flights. Having been a long time supporter of MAS, even after they had 2 major incidents, we continued to fly MAS.. Even when all our families and friends have opted other airlines, we remained with MAS But not anymore..We’ll be finding better air travel experiences with other airlines from now onwards.
reviews.author: CutiCutiTime

reviews.title: Fine once you're flying
reviews.text: We booked with Malaysia Airlines to take us to Bali via KL from London, mainly because it was the most reasonable priced flight. I would separate my experience into two sections, before flying and once flying. First, once we were flying I would rate the experience as fine. Nothing to really make MA stand out from other carriers. Food in decent, service is ok (some flight crew were lovely, some looked like they wanted to maintain as much distance between them and yourself as possible), the entertainment available was ok, seats were comfortable enough and aircraft was clean. The main issue however for me, and the reason I will avoid flying MA in the future is just experience of handling the booking prior to flying. Firstly, 20Kg luggage for such long journeys from Europe to S.E.A. is in my opinion the bare minimum. This route is going to be used by many people planning longer holidays or even trips through all the amazing countries of the region. For us on a 2 week holiday, we found ourselves constantly having to check what we were packing, especially decided which liquids to take or leave behind. Now, 20Kg starter wouldnt be so bad if you could reasonable upgrade, but this is not the case. Roughly £100 per person needs to be spent for 5Kg extra - and looking at their overweight fees you're constantly guessing whether its best to buy this or just pay anything extra at the airport. This extra fee is then added on to the seat reservation fees - I reserved seats for the outgoing flights, costing me roughly $40 which isnt too bad. However, decided to not bother on the return, expecting to get the option to select seats during check in, this isn't the case however. During check in you will assigned seats which you will have no option to change (unless you want to spend over $100 each on the a few premium options). Even if they do not wish for this service to be free, atleast keep the chargeable normal seat reservation as an option during check in???? We ended up on the very back row - with no recline for a 12 hour journey and I was powerless to change (despite checking in 48 hours prior to the flight and there being some seats empty so im sure I could have moved if the option had even been there) Overall, I think MA has made itself a budget long haul carrier which entice you with lower fair initially but then try to suck as much profit as possible from you trying to enjoy your long haul holiday - ultimately making it a more expensive ticket that flying with the better Singapore Airlines. I will avoid MA in the future, flying on them only if there is a clear cost benefit even with the add ons over its competition.
reviews.author: M C

reviews.title: Never fly Malaysia Airline again
reviews.text: I booked the flight in Feb. Malaysia airline cancelled my flight twice in Apr and May after I submitted my leave and planned everything. So I had to accept the changes. They changed flight dates twice so I had to stay in KL airport overnight and incurred additional hotel costs. Then they even charged me excessive baggage 60USD even though the weight is within the 2 ppl allowance. I didn’t have my mom’s passport with me when I checked in both luggage, so they put 2luggage under my name. I traveled with my mom and because the overnight stay in KL, she couldn’t clear immigration with me. And we had to book 2 different airport hotel, one within the immigration and one outside immigration. They both costs over 200USD per night. Don’t ever fly with Malaysia airline!
reviews.author: H C

reviews.title: Terrible service, poor management, Don't Fly Malaysian Airlines.
reviews.text: Me and my mother were traveling to New Zealand from Trivandrum. Malaysian Airlines had extremely horrible service. They were extremely rude and un welcoming. We got out of the flight to get the luggage when we realised it was misplaced. We waited for about 15-20 minutes for the luggage to realise it was misplaced. Then we filed a complaint. They said they will deliver to our home but then when we arrived home they said they only deliver in metro cities. It took a day of fighting to get a home delivery for our luggage. We got our luggage the next day we finally got our luggage to realise one wheel was broken and the suitcase was dirty and scratched. While flying Malaysian Airlines it too tigh and claustrophobic. It was just a terrible experience. For your own good please do not fly Malaysian Airlines.
reviews.author: Arnav S

reviews.title: MAS132 POOR SERVICE
reviews.text: This flight had extremely rude staff who refuse to switch your food, don't let you use empty seats and make rude comments to you. They stare at you and make faces when you ask for anything. For example I asked for an exchange of rice for bread and they made faces and didn't give me the bread even though they had it. The fact that they did that is not ok and it got me extremely pressed. Even my aunt who has a back problem. They simply refused to give her an empty seat. They were very rude. And it is a disgusting airline. Don't go on it as it is very rude staff
reviews.author: Josh

reviews.title: Business class lounge
reviews.text: I returned on the 19th of May 2023. To my utter dissapointment business class lounge at Delhi airport has been downgraded to a cafe that not only limited food but limits beverages. When I raised this with the airlines was given the run around. Am wondering how a premium airline can down grade itself to this level. To make matters worse another shock was in place during boarding to discover the type of aircraft has been downgraded from a a330 to a 737-800 aircraft.
reviews.author: Jagjit singh

reviews.title: A GOOD FLIGHT
reviews.text: It's many years since we've flown with this airline and were pleasantly surprised when everything went smoothly. When our first flight was delayed slightly, we received a prompt text advising of this. The meals were of a very high standard in fact far better than that currently provided by Qantas Air. Our only complaint was the lack of legroom which was very tight and similar to that offered in budget airlines. The landings were smooth and the standard and choice of movies/music were very good(perhaps due to the aircraft appearing to be fairly new?).
reviews.author: dalger1430

reviews.title: Worst Nightmare....aaaargh
reviews.text: After using book and pay later….could not make payment with credit card. Many error messages after numerous attempts. Numerous call centre calls could not fix this, and they made erroneous claims as to the terms on which I had made the booking. Suggesting that my booking had timed out and was no longer valid. Had several calls to MA cut off after ~ 20 mins on hold. ( Thus us normal at MA) After a few days finally got a link to a site to be able to make the payment. And I asked that the actual ticket be sent to me on that call. That never happened. Couple of days later called again. Person took long time to act, and I asked him to be sure to call me back if we got the usual cut off after 20m mins. Did not call back. Made another call. This time Philippines answered, No notation on my file that the previous call to KL had been made or any action arising from that. And they then told me there is no record of my flight being booked!! . But they confirmed that they had received my paynment!!! To avoid being cut off again she put me on hold while she contacted another department…. Got cut off after 30 minutes !!!! No call back, no email. Called again. This time I am told my booking has been cancelled for no reason and that they will keep my money and make a refund sometime in the future. Probably spent more than 4 hours in total on the phone and waiting over about 8 calls during this process over 4-5 days. If the departure date had been closer it would have been disastrous. A truely Kafkaesque experience into the realms of hell. I will NEVER EVER have anything to do with MA again.
reviews.author: Walk_On _High

reviews.title: Canceled Flight
reviews.text: Flight was cancel, force to reschedule, call up call center and was told able to place a date and change later. Due to their cancelation, had to arrange other transportation to my destination, and set a temporary reschedule date. Was given wrong info as when trying to change the flight date again was told unallow to do so. Poor service giving misguided info and causing inconvenience.
reviews.author: NG BOON C

reviews.title: Disappointing food
reviews.text: On line check in closes 24 hours before departure but then you still have to queue so what was the point of the on line check in On our overnight flight up to Kuala Lumpur you were given a snack of a little pasty then nothing until breakfast Only one round of drinks was offered overnight. No overnight bag with toothbrush in, nothing provided in the toilets either The plane was absolutely freezing we had to ask for extra blankets Second shorter flight provided a better meal Film choices on both flights very similar some newer ones but not a massive choice of films or tv series
reviews.author: den003

reviews.title: Avoid Pre Ordered Food if you can
reviews.text: Their preordered stuff are the worst. Don’t order them Unless they’re the kid’s special. Their regular meals are the best, the beef and potatoes are the best option they’re a billion times better than the pre-ordered stuff. Order it if you only badly need food restrictions, but I would rather have gluted or my acid reflux and take meds after. Only upside they were on time, and we arrived a few minutes earlier.
reviews.author: Kune D

reviews.title: Being fooled
reviews.text: My flight is late so i missed my other flight, they gave me a voucher for lunch which i found out that is only 20 MYR and that is about 5$. I will wait for about 18 hours and yeah i get 5$ for lunch which. FYI there is no restaurant that serves food with 5$ only so i have to pay extra. Its ok if some flights is late it happens alot, but getting fooled like that is NOT ok this one of the worst experiences for me flying around.
reviews.author: Moh AlAmeer

reviews.title: No full refund for fully refundable ticket
reviews.text: Do not book this airline. Worst customer service I have experienced so far. We booked a flight from Yogyakarta to Kuala Lumpur in the category Economy Flex. Economy Flex is clearly advertised as "refund without a fee", which is why we booked this category in the first place, even though it was a bit pricy. 10 days before we were supposed to fly, my partner's mother died and he had to get home as fast as he could. So we cancelled the ticket. They charged a cancellation fee of 70€ for each ticket. Remember, no refund fees. We contacted them, this was now 3 months ago. First they did not acknowledge the class we booked in. We finally got them to accept, that we indeed booked Economy Flex, which is reflected in our ticket and the price itself (around 200€ per ticket). We do actually have access to another ticket in the same class that was refunded fully, so I have no idea, why they won't give the money back. They will not give us our money back, I am in constant contact. They know the reason for cancelling is the death of a very close relative (mother), which they also simply ignore. Last try they made (which actually made me laugh) was to tell us, the 70€ each were due to conversion fees from Malaysian Ringgit to Euros... Do not book with them. They use false advertisement and their customer service is despicable.
reviews.author: Eljana

reviews.title: Budget airline OR Full service airline
reviews.text: I cannot work out if Malaysian Airlines are supposed to be a budget airline posing as a full service airline or a full service airline posing as budget. I found the flights were ok, food ok, service very good and friendly, but the inflight entertainment system has got to be 20+ years old. The IFE is slow to respond so I kept pressing buttons thinking they hadnt worked then suddenly my prior inputs would all respond at once. The latest movies were old. I did 4 flights with MH in past week, check in for each was a nightmare, queues were 100's of people long. Only 1 of 4 flights offered self service check in but it didnt work and ended up in a long queue for manual check in - even after Id checked in online anyway. MH tickets are slightly cheaper than SQ and QF, but need to weigh up how much I am willing to save for a lower standard. I think MH is ok for short haul but anything longer with sub-standard IFE I'd fly with someone else.
reviews.author: Elthamboy

reviews.title: Average
reviews.text: I book flights on cost only basis so you pay little and expect little,boarding organised and efficient,cabin crew,freindly enough,seat average,entertainment o.k.only snack as only short leg flight but adequate,cheap flight average service no complaints.
reviews.author: scubacol11

reviews.title: Spend a little bit more and get a better service.
reviews.text: Me and my wife both flew a month aprt from LHR to Bali DPS. Baggage didn't arrive in Bali for my wife for seven days , and when I flew, bags were lost for five days before delivery. MAS Worldtracer was not updated, ended up using Pakistan Airways site which seemed more up to date. Took three hours in a queue at DPS to report ( not necessarily MAS fault as handling agents used). Eventually bags in both cases turned up after several days without warning, but we were travelling around so made it very stressful as inmpossible to contact agents or airline. ZERO compensation offered at airport (unlike other airlines pax who all received vouchers for necessities). Bought some necessities at market to save money not knowing if any compensation would be forthcoming ( no receipts) to tide us over and was washing stuff in sink as needed. Claimed on return home when airline sent an email stating bags were delayed for six days and then told no compensation would be paid unless I had receipts. Nothing at all for stress. delay and inconvenience. Spend a little more and fly with an an airline that values a bit of customer service, Never again with MAS...
reviews.author: Nealfranio

reviews.title: Horrible Food
reviews.text: Board the flight from Madinah to Singapore but a stopover at KL airport. The staff were friendly, smiley and accommodating. My only complain is the food....I ask for stew chicken with rice but it turn out to be some form of sambal chicken (not spicy but red in colour, where stew chicken supposed to be black/brown) with baked vegetables and rice. The taste was really terrible. Then came our last meal, I opted for Nasi Lemak as I miss our local dishes spending 10 days in Saudi Arabia. The food had a slice of boiled egg, a little sambal which was horrible, packed ikan bilis/peanuts, rice and some form of chicken which was redish brown in colour, which was not bad. Overall, I only enjoyed the cut fruits and the desserts for both my meal. Can the relevant department please look into the matter giving prior importance. It does not mean I will not travel on Malaysia Airlines but if there is no improvement on the food than I will avoid flying this airlines. Not forgetting, I will for sure share my experience with people I know.....
reviews.author: Geetha027

reviews.title: Horrible Experience
reviews.text: Horrible experience. extra luggage cost NZ60.00 per Kg. Worst experience. Staff in India were disrespectful.
reviews.author: ganesh

reviews.title: What an absolutely horrible airlines
reviews.text: The staff are rude. No consideration for people travelling with kids. We took 5 flights in two weeks and Malayasia Airlines was the only one which harassed us for excess baggage payment and stroller with no cover. Wouldn’t recommend to anyone. Disappointment is an understatement.
reviews.author: Sanjana B

reviews.title: 4 Flghts 3 Problems
reviews.text: Malaysian airlines have been a total shambles from the start of our trip to the end. Our second leg flight involved a broken plane. A frantic dash from one side of an airport to another and no water for hours. Leg three the airline sent us to a domestic gate instead of international and so another dash across Adelaide airport to get to the right place. Water we bought for the flight had t be put in the bin and bought again because of their mistake. Now on leg four just received another email after we left the comfortable lounge we paid for to tell us this flight is delayed as well. Now no water again for hours whilst the bungling inept airline continues to mess everyone around.. We could have sat in comfort for the extra time but now we are stuck in the stuffy terminal. Save yourself a load of hassle and book with anyone else.
reviews.author: MartinaLondon11

reviews.title: Bad delay and no compensation
reviews.text: I will say that when everything goes well it's a pretty good airline, seats are a little narrow but staff were very nice. My lack of recommendation comes from having a 9 hour delay. Our first flight was delayed 2 hours so the connecting flight was missed and we got moved on to the next one resulting in a 10 hour delay in total, shouldve arrived just before 6am and we ended up landing just after 4pm. I have been in contact about this assuming there would be some restitution but Malaysia Airlines aren't covered under EU261 at all unless your flight depart from an EU member state so because this was our return flight we got offered an apology and some loyalty points which won't be much good as I now will not use an airline not covered by EU261
reviews.author: James

reviews.title: Not the MH they used to be anymore
reviews.text: Mediocre flight DPS to KUL on A330. The plane in need of upgrade or at least proper cleaning. Crew (a grumpy guy) not very friendly. I had my special meal ordered but he brought the standard one - when I said I want my vegetarian he told me 'well, perhaps next time you need to order it in advance'. It was kind of funny to see his face when he checked the list and my order was actually there. Still, no sorry, no nothing. I remember MH years ago when they were really good. Today it's like they are shadows of themselves.
reviews.author: Slawek Z

reviews.title: Here is how this scam works
reviews.text: Hi my first painful experience with this scam flight booking company, here is how they scam you , you book a flight, pay in full expecting to get the ticket, then after one or two days they send you an email apologizing for cancelling the first leg of your flight as flight overbooked while confirming the return flight, which doesn’t make sense how will you return if your first flight got cancelled, so they hook you, and they offer you a voucher not a real refund, while they know that after this painful experience 90% will just ditch their credit, I got my going flight cancelled while my return flight confirmed, so I had to swiftly go and buy direct from the airline, guess what the flight I booked directly from the airline was exact value and exact time of the flight Airpaz claimed was overbooked, so they simply lied , knowing that you will have to stick with them as the return flight already booked and no money will be refunded, clever scammers, don’t ever use this service, go directly to the airline or a reputable company, I just lost 200 dollars with those guys
reviews.author: G A

reviews.title: Consistently reliable economy
reviews.text: Economy service is excellent. Flight attendants work hard and do their best to accommodate needs within the limitations placed upon them. Same with call centre. Food was very good but I often receive luke warm to cold meals on MAS, even when close to first served. Must be a Malay thing. Note, westerners hate this. Loved the desert. Loved the snack meal. IFE has had terrible selection on all my post covid flights.
reviews.author: Peter s

reviews.title: Worst service in Chennai India
reviews.text: I had a very shocking experience with this airlines. I retuned from India. When I went to the check in counter the lady call “Anparasi” asked me “any seat preferences?” I replied “if you got any cancellations, give me next to the empty seat” she said “then you need to book a private airline” Very disgusting. Never going to fly with them again. Thanks
reviews.author: Ramya A

reviews.title: SYD-KUL Business class
reviews.text: Take off and landing was on time. There was a water bottle in the seat area. The massage function on this seat did not seem to work well, felt hardly any movement. It was very comfortable whilst seated upright. Once the seat was reclined, the foot well was very tight. I did not have a good night. A full breakfast was offered after take-off (almost midnight Sydney time). Strangely not many passengers accepted. Prior to landing a light meal was offered. I was asked every time I used the toilets whether I was a business class passenger. The paper towels in the bathroom were so thin it dissolved in wet hands. The lounge was Plaza Premium Lounge and I would not pay good money to use it. Food was limited, the pasta was congealed and the cakes/desserts was dry from sitting too long on display. Alcoholic drinks were very limited.
reviews.author: Love_Life_Sydney

reviews.title: Ms
reviews.text: I was travelling from Bangladesh to Sydney on 12th of March my flight was 12 50 I went there 11 55 because I was stuck in the traffic for a long long time and the boarding was closed.and I did online check in before but Nobody helped me I asked everyone but nobody knew nothing, then one lady took me different spots wasting my time and at the end they told me it’s too late after that another guy asked me to wait and I waited there for more than 3 hours but than the airline crew came and told me that there is nothing they can do I have to buy a new ticket. Then I bought a new ticket paying full price again. Really unprofessional staff worst flight experience and I will tell everyone to avoid it.
reviews.author: Sumaya akter sumi

reviews.title: Service standards maintained
reviews.text: The airline has gone through many crises and near-bankrupcies. However, for this business class flight, I am glad to say the standards of service the airline has been known for have been maintained. The crew addressed each passenger by name all the time. Serving of champagne and wine is done at the seat -- they pour it in front of you so that you can see the bottle, and they keep filling up your glass without being asked to. (As a side note, another Southeast Asian once had one bottle of champagne but served sparkling wine for the rest of the flight with the bottles out of sight of passengers). The weakness is the hardware. Regional configuration is dated, with immovable headrest, though the inflight entertainment is more than adequate. Another note is that though it has a full range of alcoholic beverages, it does not openly publicise it, to appease the country's despicable Islamic extremists. Alcoholic beverages are available on flights over 3 hours long. The recently reopened regional lounge at Kuala Lumpur airport is modern and well equipped, with a bar, bathrooms, dining areas, family area. Only the food choices are rather limited. Service: 5/5 Seating: 3/5 Catering: 5/5 Inflight entertainment: 4/5 Regional Lounge at Kuala Lumpur: 4/5
reviews.author: FMoz

reviews.title: NO refund yet!
reviews.text: The airlines hasn't provided the refund yet! Its been over 2 months now. Have been calling them every week to follow up, No communication or whatsoever from their end.
reviews.author: Venky

reviews.title: Think before ticket booking
reviews.text: Worst customer support. Malaysia Airlines not provided email I’d for communications. They take more than one month for refund process without reason.
reviews.author: Velmurugan M

reviews.title: Worst service, taking them to court soon
reviews.text: It’s been more than 2 months and I have still not received refund for the ticket I have booked with them with wrong details. They are soon enough to grab hold of charges and fees but won’t return when they are supposed to. They appear to not care of their own policies. Please never travel with this airline. Biggest mistake of my life
reviews.author: Salman

reviews.title: Poor Treatment by Cabin Crew
reviews.text: Staff (Supervisor Priscilla) was very Rude to me. Toilet (next to pantry) was very bad and rather than fixing it, they close it for passengers resulting in every one using just two toilets and was very difficult. For closing the TOILET door bit hard which was not closing smoothly in the first instance and I cannot go near as it was wet and stinky, she shouted at me. She did not even know what happened and did not want to listen and when I try to explain she was not ready to listen. She literally screamed in the flight and said you are wrong. She did not have any manners and started blaming me and getting into a heated exchanges with me. Poor behaviour. I was very upset and my journey and the day was completely disturbed with her behaviour. I wanted to put it aside, but decided to escalate as it was bad behaviour and needs to be escalated to avoid same experience to another passenger and spoke to another supervisor Roddick. It seems they had two supervisors and I know this would not be handled as they would cover each of them. As expected, he Listened and understood but could not and did not do anything to address the problem and just said apologies. I told him, I am available and if the supervisor (Priscilla) regrets her action, I am available to discuss and if not, I want this to be documented and reported as it is unacceptable. He said he will get back, but did not. I also said, I will escalate this from my end as the supervisor is expected to set positive examples for team, but she was rude and shouting at the passenger. I am a frequent flyer and been traveling for the past 25 years across various airlines, but my experience with Malaysian Airlines was poor. I choose this airline due to availability despite hearing negative feedback on their service levels. . They can talk to passengers politely even if there is any mistake rather than screaming at them. Serious attitude problem and treating customer like their servants and taking things for granted. I was wondering why I would book tickets and listen to all this nonsense rather than choosing a different airlines. The communication of some of the staff was poor. Radika was literally snapping at the passenger (an elderly passenger) as she had press the flight attendant call light by mistake. I was watching it from my seat and was wondering why would you behave like that?? Treat passengers with respect is my request. The only mistake they did was choosing Malaysian Airlines and I would try my level best to AVOID Malaysian Airlines in future and would be sharing my experience reviews shortly. I have never experienced this behaviour globally and the problem is with senior staff and supervisors and unless they fix the attitude, we cannot expect the other staff to behave properly when they set wrongly precedents.

reviews.title: AirPaz Ripoff
reviews.text: I booked two tickets on Airpaz, I forgot to add my middle name, it was not prompted for on the booking form! They then issued my tickey with my two surnames instead of my first, middle and surname. I tried to amend immediately, was told it would take a while for amendments to take place. Today I received notification that they want MYR 238.00 to initiate the amendment!!! This is more than the ticket itself.

reviews.title: Worst airline service! Unprofessional! Rude!
reviews.text: My mom's flight has been delayed 7 hours while she was stucked in KL! Because of this, She missed huge meeting in Korea next day and lost 500 dollers deposit and she should have wait there for 11 hours in the airport. Additionally, she did not have phone charger as we didn't expected this long delay. Firstly, I tried to ask to staffs to make sure my mom's safety and one of lady staff was yelling at me, 'There is nothing I can do! What you expect then!' It was so rude! She was basically not ready to talk to customer. The other staff also tried to shut my mom's mouth by put her into wating room and ran away. She could not speak English well and she was scared about losing contact with me as well. All other staff was not helping us and ran away whenever I tried to talk to. All we got from them was only 20 Malaysian doller for buying food from Macdonald for 11 hours. We have lost 500 dollers from this situation and reschedule this broken meeting is not going to happend. I did not even ask them to pay for that. All I asked was bring her to the comfortable place and provide her a phone charger. But they did not listen, ignored, ran away, and even blamed us. I know sometimes flight can be changed dramatically so I paid 2100 doller for Malaysian airlines instead of other 800 doller cheap flights. I trusted that Malaysian people were helpful and kind as I experienced before. Never expected this worst experience. So disspointed! Ridiculous! Rude! Unprofessional! Poor language skills! I couldn't sleep all night for worry about my mom's safety. Fortunately another customer borrowed her a phone charger and she could keep contact me and get the flight 11 hours later! Thank you so much for trouble that call yourself best service! I will never even going to Malaysia again. No point!

reviews.text: Flying out from Heathrow Airport to Kuala the service was terrible. I didn't manage to get her name. The stewardess didn't want help me with putting my cse into the overhead small luggage storage. Staff were lazy and one girl in particular had a grumpy face all the way to Kuala Lumpur. Coming back the service was impeccable. (14/03/23 - 23.45hours). Completely different expirience to the one had going. Special mention to Saw Howie Keng for who could not have been any more helpful. There was also a stewardess, unfortunately i didnt get her name but she was wearing pink eyeshadow. She was also amazing with her care and service. For this team I give 5 stars.
reviews.author: Irene Y

reviews.title: Worst Customer Service!
reviews.text: I was actually trying to book flights on MAS to take advantage of the MATTA discounted fares. There was no clear instructions on their website. When I tried booking, the fares were at full price. I called the 1300 number to find out how to go about it. Multiple calls later, I got no where because no one was picking up the phones. I finally spoke to the 1st person and she sounded very confident. She gave me the discount code and told me to go to the website, ssupport@malaysianairlines.com. I specifically asked her if this was a website or an email address because I was suspicious. She told to go to the website to book the ticket. I am not sure if it was just her poor command of English. I tried the so called website and it didn't work! I wasn't surprised! I went ahead and tried to book using the discount code given. By the way, this discount code is not advertised anywhere on the MAS website. I guess they expect customers to go hunting for it! Nothing worked. So I called again and I got a sassy young Filipino gal with an attitude. By now, I have spent a good few hours trying to crack the mystery. Finally she admitted she had no idea how to help me. The discount code, matta2023 wasn't working. She literally made me wait on the line while waiting to hear back from the team on how to solve this problem. Of course, there was no help! I hung up at that point because it was pointless. I also wrote to the MAS Facebook page. No help was provided except to give me the link to the MAS website. They ignored all my messages conveying my frustrations. This is what I wrote to them, "This is the most ridiculous thing I have experienced. This explains why MAS has a crappy reputation. Can't do nothing right. It's so pathetic it's laughable!" I also wrote on their page, "Had the most frustrating experience trying to book flights on the MAS website to get the MATTA discounted rates. I called MAS customer service twice and they could not help me figure out how to book the flights and get the discount. They had no clue! The discount code wasn't advertised and it didn't even work! Apparently now I have to write an email for support to find out how to book the flights. Seriously! Guess I'll be flying Air Asia now!" MAS should be shut down! It is a national embarrassment to deal with such incompetence.
reviews.author: Rachel A

reviews.title: Website and Call Centre a lot to be desired
reviews.text: Website: Wanted to purchase excess baggage; no flag/prompts to indicate service not avail. less than 24 hours before departure; instead automatically default into 2nd leg of trip. Called 3 times (each lasting approx. 30 mins.) to reverse transaction but all 3 calls "sang" from same hyme sheet repeating, repeating and repeating same message; asked to speak with Supervisors but none willing to take calls. Infuriating !!
reviews.author: Poh C

reviews.title: Malaysian Airlines Lost luggage
reviews.text: Poor service. I was Very excited to be able to travel & go Snowboarding again. When I arrived in Osaka I waited along time to collect my Snowboard bag for my connecting flight. This bag contained my Snowboard, Boots, Bindings, Helmet, Goggles, Gloves, Jacket, Pants & all my clothes etc. when I enquired about where is it, I was told it did not arrive & Japan Airlines filled out a report. I had to move on to my connecting flight without any of my gear. Eventually the bag was found to be left In Kuala Lumpur by Malaysian Airlines and was sent to my hotel 5 days after being lost. When I did eventually receive the bag I noticed how damaged it was. I still yet after trying to contact MA have had no response at all with any apologies or compensation of any form. Very poor customer service, very disappointing.
reviews.author: Graham H

reviews.title: Don't use this airline!
reviews.text: I booked a refundable flight expressly knowing that I would possibly need to cancel the trip, however sure enough when the time came to cancel the ticket the option was not available. I spoke two very rude customer service reps the first of which told me that I had only spent a couple of hundred dollars on a ticket. The second rep yelled and when I insisted that the ticket was not the basest ticket (low economy the only non-cancelable ticket), which was proven by the fact that I had a checked baggage allowance I was hung up on. I called back and somehow got the same woman again who now denied yelling at me and hanging up (this second call was audio recorded after the first run in), I asked to speak to a supervisor and was then again hung up on. Shady business practices from top to bottom with this airline.
reviews.author: Eric I
